name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
one_liner: A desktop app, like a design studio, where you compose a scene in 2D and 3D and then use AI to turn it into finished images or video, instead of typing a prompt and hoping.
buyer: An indie filmmaker or small creative studio who wants AI-generated shots but needs real control over composition, camera, and lighting instead of random prompt output.
business_use_cases: A small ad agency storyboards and pre-visualizes commercials in ArtCraft before committing to an expensive live shoot.
An indie game studio generates concept art and cinematic shots for a trailer without hiring a full art team.
A YouTube channel builds short AI-animated story segments for explainer or fiction content using composed scenes instead of raw text-to-video.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'storyboard-to-shot' service for small ad agencies and indie filmmakers who can't afford a pre-vis artist.
Offer template scene packs and brand-styled presets for creative studios.

steal_this: A weekend pre-visualization service: take a client's script or ad brief and deliver a set of AI-composed storyboard shots in ArtCraft by Monday.
